overview: I am a Board Certified senior Hematopathologist with four decades of clinical and diagnostic expertise in  Hematopathology Service at UAB Health System and director of  Hematology/Bone marrow laboratories, and responsible for overall QA/QC of the laboratories. I have  expertise in Flow cytometry, lymphoma, leukemia, myelodysplastic/ myeloproliferative neoplasms (MPN/MDS), plasma cell neoplasms/myeloma, and additionally in Surgical Pathology / lung malignancies. My research interests are in bone marrow biopsy  topography, tissue microarrays (TMA), immuno-architecture in the bone marrow and lymph nodes, core needle biopsy techniques, mouse models of leukemia, (FLIT3-ITD), IRESSA trial in Non-small cell lung carcinomas and CD30 expression in hematopoietic cells. Other areas of my interest are in digital imaging, image analysis, macro-photography deep image stacking, web-technology, and quantification of bone marrow hemophagocytosis in macrophage activation syndrome (MAS).  I have collaborated extensively with UAB (O’Neal) Comprehensive Cancer Center Investigators and other outside Institutions on the above research areas resulting in several peer-reviewed publications. I am on the NCCN myelodysplastic syndrome (MDS)  committee  As an educator, I developed Hematopathology teaching guidelines and curriculum for UAB Hematopathology fellowships and collaborated with other national experts in publishing training guidelines for Hematopathology programs. I have similarly developed Hematology-Oncology Module curriculum/teaching material for the UAB School of Medicine (UASOM) MS-II students.
